messages:
incident-bot: Auto summary: outage rwinf-504 impacted hosted inference in us-west-2 between 2026-03-15 07:12 - 07:43 UTC. Symptoms: elevated tail latency, ~502s for a subset of requests. Timeline + logs: https://redwood.link/outage-rwinf-504. Please schedule a PIR (30-60m) to cover timeline, mitigations, hypotheses, and actions. Suggest next 72h. Call for facilitator + 2-3 slot suggestions. :calendar:

maya: I can host the customer-facing readout but i'm OOO Tue 8-12 PT. can co-facilitate Wed morning PT.

alex: I can facilitate Wed 10:00 PT / Thu 09:00 PT. prefer Wed. i'll prep a 10-15m pre-read and the actions tracker.

samir: +1 wed. priority actions to triage during PIR: 1) investigate autoscaler misfire (need owner) 2) cache invalidation race causing stale KVs (owner?) 3) rollout/rollback playbook gaps. also need list of affected customers — cc @jess

jess: i'll join for customer readout. pls avoid 3am CET for any attendees in EMEA. i'll invite AMs for affected accounts. support thread with examples: https://redwood.link/support-1234

ops-scheduler: Doodle: https://doodle.mock/choose-slot (plz pick by EOD). proposed slots: Wed 17 Mar 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT), Wed 17 Mar 20:00 UTC (13:00 PT), Thu 18 Mar 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT). proposed facilitators: alex (primary), maya (backup).

alex: i'll take primary facilitator. draft agenda: ```
- 00:00-05:00: timeline recap (who/what/when)
- 05:00-15:00: evidence & RCA hypotheses
- 15:00-25:00: actions, owners, timelines
- 25:00-30:00: open q/A and next steps
```
will create PIR doc and attach pre-read. can @samir own autoscaler investigation? :+1:

samir: i'll take autoscaler investigation. for the cache invalidation race i'll ask @maya to own that.

maya: happy to own cache invalidation followup and prep a short repro snippet. also happy to take notes for the meeting if needed.

jess: confirmed i'll invite AMs and include the affected-customers list in the invite. pls include a 1-paragraph exec summary in the pre-read for them.

alex: will add an exec summary. current action owner list: autoscaler -> samir, cache race -> maya, pre-read & facilitation -> alex, customer comms -> jess. @ops-scheduler can you lock Wed 17 Mar 17:00 UTC if >50% pick that slot?

ops-scheduler: locking Wed 17 Mar 17:00 UTC. invite sent to SRE, infra, product, CS, and affected account teams. calendar includes PIR doc: https://redwood.link/pir-rwinf-504. if anyone needs to swap facilitator or add items, ping me here and i'll update the invite. :white_check_mark:
